S1.label: Structured data reasoning
S1.pattern: Fails to correctly parse or cross-reference structured data from tool results — wrong flight numbers from reservation details, wrong order IDs, wrong item counts from product listings

S2.label: Tool calling precision
S2.pattern: Most frequent failure: right tool selected but wrong arguments — wrong payment_id, wrong item_ids, wrong flight arrays, wrong cabin class, wrong passenger list in update/exchange/book calls

S3.label: Multi-step task completion
S3.pattern: Drops sub-tasks or completes them in wrong order — cancels without re-booking, updates one order but not another, misses last step in multi-part requests

S4.label: Precondition verification
S4.pattern: Acts without verifying conditions: exchanges/cancels non-refundable basic economy, applies refund to wrong payment method, issues unsolicited certificates, uses exchange for non-delivered orders, ignores that task is complete

S5.label: Numerical reasoning
S5.pattern: Arithmetic errors in price difference calculations, total refund amounts, or payment splits — calculate tool fails or produces wrong output

S6.label: Record discovery and retrieval
S6.pattern: Wrong user found, wrong order retrieved, item_id not found — agent looks up wrong record or fails identity lookup, blocking all subsequent actions

S7.label: Information communication
S7.pattern: Right action taken, fails to state required values — tracking numbers, refund amounts, certificate balances, item material details not communicated

S8.label: Conditional and state-aware reasoning
S8.pattern: Ignores if-then conditions or uses wrong API for current object state — uses exchange for non-delivered orders (should use modify), cancel instead of item-level modify, wrong branch of conditional logic
